read_only_comparators.identity: exact actual same state128, original tape/config/kernels/price/clock; reuse completed packets only, no old forwards

generation_diagnostic.mode: read only from actual saved committed states/maps, never extra native/prepare/energy calls
generation_diagnostic.licensed_request: L = positive_request - rejected_capacity - rejected_template, retain reconstruction rounding and raw values
generation_diagnostic.available_at_admission: Use actual admission-stage P and F. If not directly saved, reconstruct P*=next_precursor+precursor_spent; F*=next_fuel+birth_fuel. These are algebraic diagnostics with recorded tolerances, not a re-executed model. Never substitute global inventories or pre-actor F.
generation_diagnostic.joint_constraints: At each actual licensed request record P*<L and F*/original_fuel_price<L separately: P-only deficient, F-only deficient, both, neither, plus equality/roundoff. Preserve raw L/P*/F* and deficits; overlapping deficits are not additive rejected mass.
generation_diagnostic.birth_consistency: Compare actual birth to min(L,P*,fuel_affordable) under original nextafter affordability rounding; record differences. No alternative gate order or new labels.
generation_diagnostic.scope: At129 only claim same-request comparison after empirical equality; later masks vary by arm and step and are not fixed tissue or causal mediators. If source maps missing, report missing rather than rerun old paths.
